answer: Each agent files one census entry, an onyx-sealed claim on a distinct karst plot with a 70-credit bond. Each epoch auditors re-survey a sample; a rented-plot ring fails re-survey, and two entries sharing one plot burn the bond. The oasis pays one share per verified entry; duplicates add no income. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40, then 40+6(k-1): 3,037,000 + 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its oasis share.
